_note: Addendum v1.4 §3. Terms of use and robots are not yet checked for any source, so every terms_status is unknown and nothing is fetched automatically (OPEN_QUESTIONS QG1). URLs are the portals' home pages [UV]; the owner confirms each before enabling a fetch. Owner 2026-11-12 (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q145): 'take it from wherever it is available' - the official portals and a few agriculture news outlets are seeded with their robots.txt results; a deploy updates rows still unknown (never an admin's own decision). `backfill` and `departments` are reader options, not database columns.
